propositions: Step-budget exhaustion diagnostic (tool-call repetition counters) is computed by usage_log.failure_usage but stripped by _bounded_diagnostic allowlist before reaching gate_error_v1 sidecar emission
raise_completion_workflow_failure only emits gate_error_v1 when failure_diagnostic is truthy, but budget exhaustion never sets failure_diagnostic because the recovery exception path is unreachable

Operator cannot distinguish loop-caused budget exhaustion from room-exhaustion without reading logs because the distinct-vs-total tool-call count (already computed) is dropped from the operator message

_bounded_diagnostic must whitelist tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, and distinct_ratio_window to survive the merge; top_repeated_tool_calls must bypass scalar-only restriction as a list of {signature, count} dicts
raise_completion_workflow_failure must project aggregate_-prefixed diagnostic keys back to bare names and render them through format_repetition into the failure message
Privacy requirement: sidecar and message must carry only hashed signatures and counters, never tool arguments, prompts, or response text
